dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Adds concrete expert knowledge not in generic model output: a full pre‑check decision tree, exact numeric thresholds (ApproveAfterDays 0‑100, name regex, limits per account), recent 2024‑2026 feature list (macOS support, custom Sources syntax, AWS‑ApplyPatchBaseline), and a heuristic matrix for auto‑approve delay. This is specific, actionable expertise beyond a baseline model.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes AWS‑specific procedures: ordered pre‑flight checks, mandatory CONFIRM gate, snapshot of existing baseline before update, exact CLI syntax for create‑patch‑baseline, register‑patch‑baseline‑for‑patch‑group, maintenance‑window registration, and post‑verification steps. Procedures are tightly tied to SSM Patch Manager rather than generic security checks.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Provides a detailed NEVER list (5 top anti‑patterns) with explicit why, plus numerous inline warnings (product‑OS mismatch, default baseline override, missing instance role, wrong document, UNSPECIFIED compliance). However, it could include more edge‑case pitfalls such as handling API throttling or pagination errors.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete (name, version, author, license, compatibility, keywords, tags, dependencies, rich metadata). Description clearly states WHAT the skill does, WHEN to invoke, and provides activation_triggers and an invocation_schema. Minor omission: no explicit schema validation example, but overall sufficient for reliable activation.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Uses layered layout: quick reference table, mindset section, pre‑flight checklist, detailed process, common patterns, strict output contract, NEVER list, heuristic, and recent features. Critical information is front‑loaded; deeper technical details are hidden until needed. No overload of the top‑level block.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions (baseline creation, registration) are tightly constrained: pre‑checks must all PASS, CONFIRM gate required, snapshot before modification, and explicit limits on numeric fields. Non‑destructive guidance (heuristics, examples) is left open, matching task fragility appropriately.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (Mindset → Pre‑flight → Process → Output contract → NEVER → Heuristic → Recent features). The structure is consistent with other CloudOps skills, aiding comprehension.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides working CLI commands, exact output block format, and end‑to‑end example plans. Gaps: does not specify handling of a negative CONFIRM response, nor detailed error‑handling if an AWS CLI call fails (e.g., throttling, pagination limits). These omissions prevent flawless autonomous execution.
